actionable_comment_findings.claim: Select actual resource operands from the admitted authored parameter roles.
actionable_comment_findings.evidence: Buffer entries only become descriptors after lookup in signature.user_parameters(). Texture2d and Texture3d entries are inserted without checking whether any authored role has that name. StencilBindings::new later filters resources by authored user roles; the collector itself does not provide the claimed role-admission guarantee. Extra texture descriptors can also remain in the cache recipe.
actionable_comment_findings.remedy: Collect supplied resource descriptors, using authored roles to project buffer element types.
actionable_comment_findings.acceptance: Correct the function Rustdoc to describe collection and buffer type projection accurately. No runtime, resource filtering, recipe, policy or fixture changes are needed to resolve this documentation finding.

contract_reconciliation.evidence: GeneratedProgramError classifies reserved function, parameter, source protocol, resource kind and coordinate-policy failures. It has no fabricated native source. Regex creation, CoordinateParameter and TextureValue errors propagate through actual Result/anyhow paths; compute parser/compiler/device errors remain distinct. NativeOperatorSignatureError owns the two local regex-no-match classifications; regex engine construction still propagates its actual error separately. Native validity remains later shader admission, not successful lexical role extraction.
contract_reconciliation.disposition: New local-error and signature comments fit current code. No claim all malformed input receives complete WGSL validation at lexical boundary.

Empty built-in fluid source keys are paired with full descriptor/mode recipe.

contract_reconciliation.area: Fluid frame and shared native adapter
contract_reconciliation.evidence: Advect documents velocity in texels per caller time unit and matching dt; native velocity is divided by texture dimensions. Gradient and revised Divergence comments state numerical 1/(2dx) coefficient in caller shared pressure/velocity/grid-spacing frame. Shared GeneratedBinding texture adapter clones actual resource variants, local rejects buffers and projects actual extents into size lanes (unused1). All six current fluid files freshly read.
contract_reconciliation.disposition: Numerical-frame comments agree with arithmetic, without asserting finite coefficient, matching physical grids/dimensions, same Device, full resource compatibility or native acceptance.

contract_reconciliation.evidence: Stencil now wires ordered signature, bindings, boundary declarations, generated program and neighborhood emission; optional center and Neighbors1D..4D source roles retained. Authored protocol shape and projected native source are not full source validity proof. Scalar index/population addressing requirements combine separately with native layout.
contract_reconciliation.disposition: Earlier unwired-status limitation is superseded only for exact frozen bodies; implementation/native integration still not cleared. C1 needs wording correction.

contract_reconciliation.evidence: Layout derives axes from actual resources and declared size semantics, using reflected actual input/output array strides and logical extents for buffers. It checks positive active grid axes, clamp/wrap signed intermediates, widened population products, unsigned flat divisors, output coverage/population and actual input capacity/projected axes. Empty controlling output returns before nonempty-neighborhood checks. Default64 has one owner shared by declaration and runtime admission. Buffer2D/3D coordinates now unflatten using that grid; texture fetch axis projections and directional aliases remain explicit source behavior.
contract_reconciliation.disposition: Comments correctly scope this proof to signed sample/grid arithmetic rather than workgroup launch shape or complete physical/native resource proof. No complete shader/compiler/runtime verdict from source reads.

Root native observation remains selected mutable blocking_validation policy plus browser cfg, and finish/submission is the actual deferred native boundary.
